The '''New Holstice system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Maldrood sector/Legends|Maldrood sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Holstice/Legends|New Holstice]].
